name: Aienkien ~Kashiwagisou e Youkoso~
original_name: あいえんきえん～柏木荘へようこそ～
source:
Main character arrives to a small town to enter a college. His apartment manager Asahi is a cute girl, and he soon finds himself in relations with her. But there is also a strange person Yuki, Asahi's mother. Actually, she is a ghost. Protagonist wants to lead a normal college life, but these two females don't leave him at peace.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角來到一座小鎮上大學。
公寓管理員朝日是個可愛的女孩，他很快和她有了進一步的關係。
但朝日的母親夕月也是個古怪的人；實際上，她是幽靈。
主角想過普通的大學生活，這兩位女性卻不讓他安寧。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
